text: おまえに　ぬけられるかな？

structure.en: I wonder if it's possible to get through?

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.span: おまえに　ぬけられる
patterns.explanation: ぬけられる is ぬける, 'get through', changed to mean 'can get through'. The に after おまえ shows who is able to do it. おまえに　ぬけられる = 'you can get through'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', and here it sounds like doubting the listener. ぬけられるかな = 'I wonder if you can get through'.
